_note: CANDIDATE source-register entries for human review, matching docs/model/dataset-source-register.json schema (asl-pilot-dataset-source-register/v1). NOT yet applied to the live register. License fields marked UNVERIFIED must be confirmed from primary sources before redistributing any derived labels/crops. Produced from 2026-05-29 fact-checked source-discovery research.

proposed_changes.rationale: Project owner approved (2026-05-29) using offline-derived labels of any method as training/eval supervision, provided no pretrained model runs at browser inference. This supersedes the raw-video-only clause for derived LABELS only.
proposed_changes.proposed_allowed_use_summary: PopSign ASL v1.0 game-category videos approved for raw-frame training, signer-disjoint validation/test, and pilot submission with CC BY 4.0 attribution. OFFLINE-derived region boxes / pose / landmark labels (e.g. MediaPipe Holistic, RTMPose) ARE permitted as training/evaluation supervision for scratch-trained project models. NO pretrained detector/landmark/backbone/embedding model may run in the browser runtime or be shipped as a promoted artifact; only the project's own from-scratch model runs at inference.
proposed_changes.redistribution_note: CC BY 4.0 permits redistribution with attribution; derived label files are OK to keep/share with attribution.

proposed_changes.rationale: Already a registered source_id; research confirms HIGH domain fit (84k webcam ASL videos, 52 signers). Confirm current allowed_for_model_training/validation and apply the same offline-derived-labels permission.
proposed_changes.license_review_status_observed: Microsoft Research custom license: non-commercial research use OK; PROHIBITS redistributing the data or modifications; mandates destroying personal data after research.
proposed_changes.redistribution_note: Local training/eval fine; do NOT publish ASL Citizen frames or derived crops. Keep derived labels local.

proposed_changes.intended_use: Generic SEED/pretrain stage only (third-person, medium-low domain fit). Uniquely ships face_box + lefthand_box + righthand_box + body keypoints -> all 4 target boxes derivable from one set. Annotations sit atop COCO images (CC BY 4.0 images, separate Flickr image rights); WholeBody annotation license NOT confirmed by research and MUST be verified from primary source before redistributing derived artifacts.

Generic SEED alternative/complement to COCO-WholeBody. 136 keypoints (26 body + 68 face + 21 L-hand + 21 R-hand); ships only a single person box, so head/face and hand boxes must be DERIVED from per-region keypoint clusters. License not established in research; verify before use.

deprioritized.wider-face: CC BY-NC-ND (NoDerivatives) — cannot redistribute derived crops; single region; LOW domain fit.
deprioritized.oxford-hand / coco-hand / tv-hand / egoh: LOW domain fit (movies/pedestrians/egocentric), single region, licenses mostly unverified. Optional hand-box augmentation only.
deprioritized.wlasl / ms-asl: Already-known in-domain ASL video but ship only one coarse person box (auto YOLOv3/SSD); use for signer diversity / person-box seed, not the 4 regions.
